description: Kora Core — Load Test Dashboard (k6 + Spring Boot Micrometer)

targets.query: SELECT percentile("value", 50) AS "p50" FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("value", 95) AS "p95" FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT percentile("value", 99) AS "p99" FROM "http_req_duration" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT non_negative_derivative(max("value"), 1s) AS "req/sec" FROM "http_reqs" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") AS "error rate" FROM "http_req_failed" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: DB Throughput — connection checkouts/sec (Kora)
panels.description: Une transaction (TX-1, TX-2, lecture) = un emprunt de connexion. Le count du timer hikaricp.connections.usage est un delta par pas d'export (10 s), d'où le /10. Si le pas change dans application-perf.yaml, changer le diviseur.

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") / 10 AS "checkouts/sec" FROM "hikaricp_connections_usage" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)

panels.title: JVM Heap Usage — MB (Kora)
panels.description: Somme des pools heap (eden, survivor, old gen), un point par pool et par intervalle avant la somme.

targets.query: SELECT sum("used") AS "heap used (MB)" FROM (SELECT mean("value") / 1048576 AS "used" FROM "jvm_memory_used" WHERE "area" = 'heap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "id") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

SELECT sum("committed") AS "heap committed (MB)" FROM (SELECT mean("value") / 1048576 AS "committed" FROM "jvm_memory_committed" WHERE "area" = 'heap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval), "id") WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Applicative Latency p50 / p95 / p99 — Spring Boot (Kora)
panels.description: Latence côté serveur mesurée par Micrometer (hors réseau k6), /actuator exclu. Percentiles calculés par l'application, un par endpoint : le panneau trace le pire endpoint (max), pas un percentile global. Comparer avec le panneau k6 pour quantifier l'overhead réseau.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "p50" FROM "http_server_requests_percentile" WHERE "phi" = '0.5' AND "uri" !~ /actuator/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("value") AS "p95" FROM "http_server_requests_percentile" WHERE "phi" = '0.95' AND "uri" !~ /actuator/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT max("value") AS "p99" FROM "http_server_requests_percentile" WHERE "phi" = '0.99' AND "uri" !~ /actuator/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: HikariCP — Pool Active / Pending + Acquire p95 (Kora)
panels.description: active et pending sont des gauges relevées toutes les 10 s : une connexion tenue ~10-20 ms est rarement vue, d'où max() et non mean(). Le débit se lit sur le panneau DB Throughput ; le temps d'acquisition p95 est le signal de saturation.

targets.query: SELECT max("value") AS "active" FROM "hikaricp_connections_active" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
SELECT max("value") AS "pending" FROM "hikaricp_connections_pending" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
SELECT max("value") AS "acquire p95 (ms)" FROM "hikaricp_connections_acquire_percentile" WHERE "phi" = '0.95' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(none)

panels.title: Applicative Throughput — req/sec (Kora)
panels.description: Requêtes vues par Spring MVC, /actuator exclu. count est un delta par pas d'export (10 s), d'où le /10.

targets.query: SELECT sum("count") / 10 AS "req/sec" FROM "http_server_requests" WHERE "uri" !~ /actuator/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(10s) fill(0)
